title: Curve Go Overview – Curve Dental
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50146794650771-Curve-Go-Overview#main-content)

* * *

**Description:**

This quick guide provides an overview of how to set up and use Curve Go.

**About:**

Curve Go enables a clinic to present a digital treatment plan or patient forms to a patient on an electronic device (e.g., iPad, tablet, desktop computer) which can then be electronically signed by the patient.

**Steps:**

Included below are the steps to set up and use Curve Go:

1. [Installing the Curve Portal Application (Curve Go) on the device.](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50146562178323-Installing-the-Curve-Portal-Application-or-Curve-GO-on-a-Desktop-Computer-or-Mobile-Device)
2. [Registering the Curve Portal or Curve Go on the device.](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50146718355091-Registering-and-Opening-the-Curve-Portal-Application-or-Curve-Go-on-a-Device)
3. [Open Curve Go on the registered device.](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/55439935848339-Registering-and-Opening-the-Curve-Portal-Application-or-Curve-Go-on-a-Device)
4. [Obtain the patient's electronic signature for the treatment plan on the device](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50882339180307-Obtaining-a-Signature-for-a-Treatment-Plan-in-Curve-GO).
5. [Opening an Incomplete Form for a Patient to Complete in Curve Go.](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50387613166995-Completing-Forms-Inside-Curve-GO)
